title: Builder Signals · 2026-11-14
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 38 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 12 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings: Claude joins calls as a visible participant—you can ask it questions out loud or in chat, or have it start a doc, while the team watches what it builds and corrects it as it takes shape. After the call, notes, action items, the transcript and anything Claude built land on the meeting's page in Claude. It starts with Google Meet, with other video platforms coming soon.
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 正式发布 Claude Meetings：Claude 以可见参会者身份加入会议，你可以口头或在聊天框里向它提问，也可以让它当场起草文档，团队成员能实时看到它在构建什么并随时纠正。会后，笔记、行动项、完整转录以及 Claude 在会上产出的所有内容都会汇总到该会议在 Claude 中的页面。首发支持 Google Meet，其他视频会议平台即将支持。

featured.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic 研究员
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic researcher Alex Albert argues that getting good work out of Claude now is mostly about finding the context it's missing and closing that gap. Claude Meetings is one way to bring in the remaining slices of context, and he says it has proved very useful internally.
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 研究员 Alex Albert 给出了一个很实用的判断：现在想从 Claude 身上拿到好结果，很大程度上就是找出它缺失的上下文、并想办法补上这个缺口。他认为 Claude Meetings 正是把「剩下那部分上下文」（会议里的讨论）带进来的一种方式，在 Anthropic 内部已经被证明非常有用。

featured.title: Powering AI-Driven Drug Discovery with President of Isomorphic Labs Max Jaderberg
featured.summaryEn: The real bottleneck in drug discovery is synthesizing atoms and testing them in the real world—Isomorphic aims to move drug design onto a computer so wet labs are for validation, not trial and error. Max Jaderberg is president and a founding team member of Isomorphic Labs. After a computer vision PhD at Oxford (his team built the 2014 ImageNet-winning network), he sold his startup to DeepMind and worked on AlphaGo and AlphaStar. AlphaFold convinced him and Demis Hassabis that deep learning could generalize in biology, leading to Isomorphic's founding in 2021 with the goal of solving all disease. His diagnosis: despite exploding knowledge and new modalities, new drug approvals are flat, costs reached ~$1.5B per drug and timelines ~15 years, because medicine-making remains empirical trial and error where each program is a bespoke science project with little transfer. An AI platform lets e…
featured.insightZh: 药物研发真正的瓶颈是「在真实世界合成原子再做实验」——Isomorphic 的目标是把药物发现整体搬到计算机上，让湿实验只用于验证、而不是试错。 Max Jaderberg 是 Isomorphic Labs 总裁、创始团队成员。他早年在牛津做计算机视觉博士，团队拿下 2014 年 ImageNet 冠军网络，创业公司后被 DeepMind 收购，在 DeepMind 参与了 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 等项目。AlphaFold 的成果让他们确信深度学习能在生物学中真正泛化，于是 2021 年与 Demis Hassabis 一起拆出 Isomorphic，使命是「解决所有疾病」。 他对新药产出停滞的诊断很尖锐：几十年来知识爆炸、药物模态增多，但每年获批新药数量持平，单药成本涨到约 15 亿美元、周期拉长到 15 年。根源是制药一直是经验驱动的试错过程，每个药物项目都像一次性的前沿科研，经验难以迁移；低垂果实摘完后越来越难。AI 平台的价值在于让每做一个药都反哺底层模型，形成复利。Isomorphic 内部每个排行榜上都画着一条「实验精度」虚线——模型达到这条线，就不必再进实验室。他还指出，大鼠毒理对人体临床毒性的预测力只有约 30%，「如果我的 AI 科学家拿来一个 30% 准确率的模型，我会让他再改进一下」——未来可以结合体外指标、类器官/器官芯片与 AI 模型，直接建模人体毒性。 商业上，Isomorphic 不卖模型、不卖 token，只用自研引擎做药：一部分是全自有管线（聚焦肿瘤、免疫与炎症），一部分与药企合作攻克对方多年无解的难题。他认为分子设计精度提升后，低毒、无相互作用的「药物鸡尾酒」组合疗法将成为可能。首个临床试验未给具体时间，但他表示：五年后如果疾病生物学的预测能力还没发生质变，他会「非常失望」。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper shared Claude's first time sitting in on one of his meetings, and posted a Žižek-style riff on the Jensen Huang affair: the real infidelity is systemic. America tells Nvidia it is married to national security and must not sell its best chips to China, while also celebrating it as the hero of American capitalism that should sell as many chips as possible. The system wants two incompatible things—containing China and dominating the Chinese market.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 一边晒出 Claude 第一次旁听他开会的反应，一边用一段模仿齐泽克腔调的长文点评 Jensen Huang 事件：他认为真正的「不忠」不在个人层面，而在制度本身——美国一方面要求 Nvidia 服从国家安全、不向中国出售最强芯片，另一方面又要求它作为美国资本主义英雄尽可能多卖芯片。体系本身同时想要「遏制中国」和「主导中国市场」这两个互不相容的目标，出事只是迟早的事。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google VP（Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio）
items.summaryEn: Google VP Josh Woodward introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, now in the Gemini App—"cutting-edge intelligence for everyone," fast, smart and a big jump. Google also launched "Gemini, now from your point of view" wearables, available for pre-order today with demos in select Warby Parker, Gentle Monster and Google stores, shipping December 10.
items.insightZh: Google VP Josh Woodward 宣布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 上线 Gemini App，定位「人人可用的前沿智能」——快、聪明、是一次大幅跃升。同时 Google 推出「从你的视角看世界的 Gemini」可穿戴设备，今天开放预订，可在部分 Warby Parker、Gentle Monster 和 Google 门店体验，12 月 10 日发货。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie shared early-access results for Gemini 4 Hydrogen on the Box AI Complex Work Eval (real-world enterprise document tasks across finance, consulting, life sciences and more): 5 points more accurate than Gemini 3.8 Flash, finishing tasks in less than half the time with about 12% fewer tokens. He calls it a serious jump for fast models; Hydrogen is rolling out in Box AI Studio for customers to build custom agents.
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 披露了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 在 Box AI 复杂工作评测（覆盖金融、咨询、生命科学等行业企业文档的真实任务）上的早期测试结果：准确率比 Gemini 3.8 Flash 高 5 个百分点，更关键的是完成任务用时不到一半、典型任务 token 消耗少约 12%。他评价这是「快速模型的一次重大跃升」，Hydrogen 将很快上线 Box AI Studio，客户可用它构建自定义 Agent。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux said OpenAI announced new cybersecurity tools in development covering automated patching and automated red teaming (recording linked). Dots also shipped updates, with the banked reset activated and landing in accounts soon. He also asked the community how Codex can be improved—"try not to say model."
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 透露，OpenAI 今天发布了正在开发的网络安全工具，涵盖自动化补丁和自动化红队测试（附录播链接）；dots 也上线了一批更新，「banked reset」已激活、即将到达所有用户账户。他还向社区征集「除了模型之外，Codex 还能怎么改进」。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 作者、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger, now at OpenAI, shared his team's write-up on running persistent agents inside OpenAI, polled whether people would enable yolo mode for dots despite the risk of unwanted actions, and warned that marketers are paying for positive X posts about a new agent launching this week—look for honest reviews.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 作者、现任职 OpenAI 的 Peter Steinberger 分享了团队关于「如何在 OpenAI 内部运行持久化 Agent」的文章；并在社区发起讨论：即使 dot 可能做出意料之外的事，你会为它开启 yolo 模式吗？他还提醒，本周将有新 Agent 发布，营销方正花大价钱买 X 上的好评，注意甄别真实评测。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch launched UI SDK, arguing frameworks and component libraries must "drill deeper" in the agent era. He frames UI SDK as the x86 instruction set for agents to build UI components on the fly—packaged behaviors for accessibility, performance and cohesion that save tokens and errors with zero limits on what UIs can be generated. High-level, rigid, single-framework abstractions are kryptonite for agents, which he calls the new design engineers.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布 UI SDK，并抛出一个观点：Agent 时代框架和组件库（包括 shadcn）需要「往更底层钻」。他把 UI SDK 比作 Agent 即兴构建 UI 组件的「x86 指令集」——把可访问性、性能、一致性封装成行为包，帮 Agent 省 token、少出错，却对能生成什么样的 UI 零限制。他认为高层、僵化、绑定单一框架的抽象，对 Agent 这种「无限、不知疲倦的创造机器」来说是克星；Agent 就是新一代设计工程师。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced that Replit Agent can now buy things for your business, including purchasing ads to acquire new customers—extending the agent from building to spending on growth. He also commented on the Jensen affair and the politics of China hawkishness.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 宣布 Replit Agent 现在可以替你的业务采购东西，包括直接投放广告来获取新客户——Agent 从「写代码」延伸到「花钱做增长」。他同时就 Jensen 事件和对华强硬政治话语发表了评论。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark partner Matt Turck assessed what the AI ecosystem loses with Jensen: its central banker (backstops), its most active investor, and a bold acquirer—with "extra kudos to Hugging Face for perhaps the best timing in large M&A history." Those aggressive moves, he says, only a founder can make.
items.insightZh: FirstMark 合伙人 Matt Turck 评估了 Jensen 事件对 AI 生态的影响：生态将失去它的「中央银行」（各种兜底支持）、最活跃的投资者，以及一位大胆的收购者——他特别提到 Hugging Face 的大型并购时机「可能是并购史上最佳」。他认为这类激进动作只有创始人才做得出来。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang made "The Jensen Huang scandal, explained over text" with just two prompts—you can interrupt anytime by sending your own text and asking a question. She finds it a highly engaging way to absorb information, a small example of AI-native content formats.
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 用两条 prompt 做了一个「用聊天短信形式讲解 Jensen Huang 丑闻」的交互作品，读者可以随时插话发问打断。她认为这种形式是吸收信息的一种非常有吸引力的方式——一个 AI 原生内容形态的小样本。
